chapters.summary: Council staff calls the meeting to order and reminds attendees to silence electronic devices and not approach the front desk.
chapters.title: Call to Order and Housekeeping

utterances.speaker: Council Staff
utterances.text: Good morning and welcome to today's New York City Council vote for the Committee on Sanitation and Solid Waste Management.

utterances.speaker: Council Staff
utterances.text: At this time, we please ask that you silence all electronic devices.

utterances.speaker: Council Staff
utterances.text: Please do not approach the front desk.

chapters.summary: Chair Justin E. Sanchez welcomes members, notes the back-to-school season, and states the purpose of the hearing is to vote on Introduction 906-A, which he sponsors.
chapters.title: Chair Sanchez Opens Hearing on Intro 906-A

utterances.speaker: Justin E. Sanchez
utterances.text: Good morning, everyone, and happy back to school.

utterances.speaker: Justin E. Sanchez
utterances.text: And welcome to today's hearing hosted by the Committee on Sanitation and Solid Waste Management.

utterances.speaker: Justin E. Sanchez
utterances.text: The purpose of this hearing is to hold a vote on Introduction 906A, sponsored by me.

chapters.summary: Chair Sanchez explains that Intro 906-A requires DSNY to dispatch employees within 14 days to evaluate and enforce waste prohibitions after seven or more credible dog waste complaints on the same block within a seven-day period.
chapters.title: Chair Sanchez Explains the Dog Waste Complaint Bill

utterances.speaker: Justin E. Sanchez
utterances.text: The committee previously heard this bill along with others included in the SCOOP Act on a hearing on May 19, 2026, where it received testimony from representatives of the Department of Sanitation and interested members of the public.

utterances.speaker: Justin E. Sanchez
utterances.text: Introduction number 906A would require DSNY upon receiving seven or more credible complaints

utterances.speaker: Justin E. Sanchez
utterances.text: of dog waste on the same city block within a seven-day period to dispatch employees within 14 days to evaluate the block and enforce, as appropriate, state and local prohibitions against animal waste in public spaces.

chapters.summary: Chair Sanchez turns the proceedings over to Committee Clerk William Martin to conduct the roll call vote on Introduction 906-A.
chapters.title: Chair Sanchez Yields to Clerk for Roll Call Vote

utterances.speaker: Justin E. Sanchez
utterances.text: I will now turn it over to the clerk to take a vote on intro 906A.

chapters.summary: Committee Clerk William Martin calls the roll for the vote on Introduction 906-A. Councilmembers Sanchez, Louis, Hanif, Hankerson, Maloney, Santosuosso, Thomas-Henry, Wilson, and Vernikov cast their votes.
chapters.title: Roll Call Vote on Intro 906-A

utterances.speaker: William Martin
utterances.text: William Martin, Committee Clerk, Roll Call Vote Committee on Sanitation and Solid Waste Management.

chapters.summary: Committee Clerk William Martin announces the vote result: 11 in the affirmative, zero in the negative, and no abstentions. The item is approved by the committee.
chapters.title: Committee Approves Intro 906-A 11-0

utterances.speaker: William Martin
utterances.text: With a vote of 11 in the affirmative, zero in the negative, and no abstentions, item has been approved by the committee.

chapters.summary: Chair Sanchez thanks the committee, gives a shout-out to Councilmember Virginia Maloney on her birthday, and officially closes the Committee on Sanitation and Solid Waste Management hearing.
chapters.title: Chair Sanchez Closes Hearing and Recognizes Councilmember Maloney's Birthday

utterances.speaker: Justin E. Sanchez
utterances.text: And I want to give a huge, huge, huge shout out to Councilmember Virginia-Maloney on her birthday today.

utterances.speaker: Justin E. Sanchez
utterances.text: And with that, the Committee on Sanitation and Solid Waste Management is closed.

utterances.speaker: Justin E. Sanchez
utterances.text: Well, I mean, they invited me to go to the event, but I didn't get invited to.

summary: The Committee on Sanitation and Solid Waste Management, chaired by Justin E. Sanchez, held a hearing on Introduction 906-A, a bill to amend the administrative code regarding dog waste complaints.
The bill requires DSNY to dispatch employees to evaluate and enforce waste prohibitions after seven or more credible complaints of dog waste on the same city block within a seven-day period.
The committee voted 11-0 to approve Introduction 906-A, with no abstentions.
title: Committee on Sanitation and Solid Waste Management
